methods.what: Criterion: Ω becomes infinite if the limiting function is discontinuous along a line, or at a point in such a way that the Dirichlet integral diverges

methods.what: Existence argument for a minimum (Dirichlet principle): Ω is finite and nonnegative, hence a minimum must exist
methods.quote: so bleibt {+das Integral+} $\Omega$ immer endlich und wird seiner Natur nach nie negativ; es muss also ein Minimum
